name: ILLBot
description: The ultimate Geometry Dash botting suite for Impossible Levels (ILL), featuring Silicate-styled draggable GUI, full custom keybinds for all functions, independent P1/P2 Autoclickers, TPS Changer, Replay Macro, Trajectory and Hitboxes.

gui-pos-x.name: GUI Position X
gui-pos-x.description: Saved horizontal coordinate of the draggable menu window.

gui-pos-y.name: GUI Position Y
gui-pos-y.description: Saved vertical coordinate of the draggable menu window.

key-menu.name: Menu Hotkey
key-menu.description: Keycode to toggle the ILLBot GUI window (Default: 9 for Tab).

key-p1-auto.name: P1 Autoclicker Hotkey
key-p1-auto.description: Keycode to toggle Player 1 Autoclicker (Default: 90 for Z).

key-p2-auto.name: P2 Autoclicker Hotkey
key-p2-auto.description: Keycode to toggle Player 2 Autoclicker (Default: 88 for X).

key-tps.name: TPS Bypass Hotkey
key-tps.description: Keycode to toggle custom TPS bypass (Default: 66 for B).

key-trajectory.name: Trajectory Hotkey
key-trajectory.description: Keycode to toggle Trajectory Visualizer (Default: 84 for T).

key-hitboxes.name: Hitboxes Hotkey
key-hitboxes.description: Keycode to toggle Hitboxes Visualizer (Default: 72 for H).

key-macro-record.name: Macro Record Hotkey
key-macro-record.description: Keycode to start/stop Macro Recording (Default: 82 for R).

key-macro-play.name: Macro Play Hotkey
key-macro-play.description: Keycode to start/stop Macro Playback (Default: 80 for P).

key-noclip.name: Noclip Hotkey
key-noclip.description: Keycode to toggle Noclip (Default: 78 for N).

p1-cps.name: P1 CPS (Clicks Per Second)
p1-cps.description: Clicks per second for Player 1 (from 1 to 2000 CPS).

p1-hold-mode.name: P1 Hold Mode
p1-hold-mode.description: If enabled, P1 only autoclicks while holding click/key. If disabled, spams continuously.

p2-hold-mode.name: P2 Hold Mode
p2-hold-mode.description: If enabled, P2 only autoclicks while holding Player 2 input.

tps-enabled.name: TPS Bypass / Changer
tps-enabled.description: Enable custom physics ticks per second (TPS).

speedhack-value.name: Game Speed Multiplier
speedhack-value.description: Speedhack multiplier (e.g. 0.25x for building/botting, 1.0x for normal).

show-trajectory.name: Show Trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Show forward flight/jump trajectory with hazard collision and death marker.

show-hitboxes.name: Show Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Show hitboxes for player, solids, and hazards.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Prevent submitting scores to online leaderboards when cheats are active.
